judgement.reason: Jenkins is a Java automation server that keeps all of its core data (jobs, configuration, build history, plugins) in a local JENKINS_HOME directory, and Deployz provides no persistent disk for it.

evidence.quote: In a nutshell, Jenkins is the leading open-source automation server.
